class.name: JRPGMapFiles
class.brief_description: Reads map scenes without instancing them and keeps map IDs unique.
class.description: Tools, the map list and servers read a map's [JRPGMapData] from its scene file through the scene's stored state, without creating any node.

method.name: read_map_data
method.description: Returns the [JRPGMapData] of the map scene at [param path], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: read_map_data_from
method.description: Returns the [JRPGMapData] stored by the root node of [param scene], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: scan
method.description: Checks the map scenes [param scene_paths] against [param list]. When two scenes claim one map ID (a copied file), the scene the list names, or else the one modified first, keeps it; the other gets a fresh ID, saved into its scene, with a warning. Scenes the list lacks are added. Returns a dictionary with [code]reassigned[/code] ([code]{scene, old_id, new_id}[/code] entries) and [code]added[/code] ([code]{scene, map_id}[/code] entries).
